Package neqsim.process.equipment.distillation

Class SarirAtmosphericFractionationResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.distillation.SarirAtmosphericFractionationResult
public final class SarirAtmosphericFractionationResult extends Object
Immutable engineering summary for a solved SarirAtmosphericFractionationCase.

Published plant rates are retained as read-only comparison evidence. They are not solver controls, tuning targets, or acceptance thresholds.

    • evaluate

      public static SarirAtmosphericFractionationResult evaluate(SarirAtmosphericFractionationCase model)
      Evaluate an already solved Sarir atmospheric-fractionation case.
      Parameters:
      model - solved case to evaluate
      Returns:
      immutable calculated-product and convergence summary
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if model is null
      IllegalStateException - if the case is unsolved, used fallback products, is non-conservative, or contains invalid or unordered material-product results
